purpose.statement: COPAUS0C is a CICS COBOL IMS BMS program within the CardDemo Authorization Module. Its primary function is to present a paginated summary view of pending authorization messages for a given credit card account. It retrieves account, customer, and card cross-reference data from VSAM files and reads Pending Authorization Summary and Detail segments from an IMS database, then displays up to five authorization records per screen page using BMS map COPAU0A.

code_references.snippet:
* Program     : COPAUS0C.CBL
      * Application : CardDemo - Authorization Module
      * Type        : CICS COBOL IMS BMS Program
      * Function    : Summary View of Authoriation Messages
       PROGRAM-ID. COPAUS0C.

MAIN-PARA.
           SET ERR-FLG-OFF TO TRUE
           SET AUTHS-NOT-EOF TO TRUE
           SET NEXT-PAGE-NO TO TRUE
           SET SEND-ERASE-YES TO TRUE
           ...
           EXEC CICS RETURN
                     TRANSID (WS-CICS-TRANID)
                     COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC.

05 WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY           PIC X(08) VALUE 'COPAUS0C'.
         05 WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL            PIC X(08) VALUE 'COPAUS1C'.
         05 WS-PGM-MENU                PIC X(08) VALUE 'COMEN01C'.
         05 WS-CICS-TRANID             PIC X(04) VALUE 'CPVS'.

business_rules.statement: On first entry (EIBCALEN = 0), the communication area is initialized and the account ID input field cursor is positioned, then the empty summary screen is displayed. This represents a fresh start with no account context.

code_references.snippet:
IF EIBCALEN = 0
               INITIALIZE CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
               MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY    TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
               SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER    TO TRUE
               MOVE LOW-VALUES          TO COPAU0AO
               MOVE -1                  TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
              PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN

business_rules.statement: On second and subsequent entries when the program is not re-entering (first pass from another program), the account ID from the commarea is validated for numeric content, then account details are gathered and the screen is displayed with ERASE.

code_references.snippet:
IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER
                  SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER     TO TRUE
                  MOVE LOW-VALUES           TO COPAU0AO
                  IF CDEMO-ACCT-ID IS NUMERIC
                     MOVE CDEMO-ACCT-ID     TO WS-ACCT-ID
                                               ACCTIDO OF COPAU0AO
                  ELSE
                     MOVE SPACE             TO ACCTIDO OF COPAU0AO
                     MOVE LOW-VALUES        TO WS-ACCT-ID
                  END-IF
                  PERFORM GATHER-DETAILS
                  SET SEND-ERASE-YES TO TRUE
                  PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN

business_rules.statement: The Account ID entered on the screen must not be blank or low-values; if it is, an error message 'Please enter Acct Id...' is displayed and the cursor is repositioned to the account ID field.

code_references.snippet:
IF ACCTIDI OF COPAU0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES
              MOVE LOW-VALUES                 TO WS-ACCT-ID
              MOVE 'Y'                        TO WS-ERR-FLG
              MOVE
              'Please enter Acct Id...'       TO WS-MESSAGE
              MOVE -1                         TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI

business_rules.statement: The Account ID entered on the screen must be numeric; if non-numeric, an error message 'Acct Id must be Numeric ...' is displayed and the cursor is repositioned to the account ID field.

code_references.snippet:
IF ACCTIDI OF COPAU0AI IS NOT NUMERIC
                MOVE LOW-VALUES               TO WS-ACCT-ID
                MOVE 'Y'                      TO WS-ERR-FLG
                MOVE
                'Acct Id must be Numeric ...' TO WS-MESSAGE
                MOVE -1                       TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI

business_rules.statement: A user may select one of up to five displayed authorization records by entering 'S' or 's' in the corresponding selection field (SEL0001I through SEL0005I). The selected authorization key is stored in CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED. Any value other than 'S'/'s' results in the error message 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S'.

code_references.snippet:
EVALUATE TRUE
                  WHEN SEL0001I OF COPAU0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES
                   MOVE SEL0001I OF COPAU0AI TO CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG
                   MOVE CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(1)
                                             TO CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED
                  ...
                  WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE SPACES   TO CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG
                   MOVE SPACES   TO CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED
                END-EVALUATE
                ...
                   EVALUATE CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG
                     WHEN 'S'
                     WHEN 's'
                        MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL  TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
                        ...
                     WHEN OTHER
                       MOVE
                       'Invalid selection. Valid value is S'
                                              TO WS-MESSAGE

business_rules.statement: When a valid 'S' selection is made for an authorization record, control is transferred via CICS XCTL to the Authorization Detail program (COPAUS1C), passing the communication area including the selected authorization key.

code_references.snippet:
WHEN 'S'
                     WHEN 's'
                        MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL  TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
                        MOVE WS-CICS-TRANID   TO CDEMO-FROM-TRANID
                        MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM
                        MOVE 0                TO CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT
                        SET CDEMO-PGM-ENTER   TO TRUE
                        EXEC CICS
                            XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM)
                            COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
                        END-EXEC

business_rules.statement: PF3 key navigates back to the main menu program (COMEN01C) by issuing a CICS XCTL to the menu program stored in WS-PGM-MENU.

code_references.snippet:
WHEN DFHPF3
                       MOVE WS-PGM-MENU        TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
                       PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
                       PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN

IF CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES OR SPACES
               MOVE 'COSGN00C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-CICS-TRANID  TO CDEMO-FROM-TRANID
           MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM
           MOVE ZEROS           TO CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT
           EXEC CICS
               XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM)
               COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC.

business_rules.statement: PF7 key scrolls backward one page through the authorization list. If the current page number is greater than 1, it decrements the page number, retrieves the previous page's starting key from CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG, repositions in IMS, and redisplays. If already on page 1, the message 'You are already at the top of the page...' is shown.

code_references.snippet:
IF CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM > 1
              COMPUTE CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM = CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM - 1
              MOVE CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG(CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM)
                                           TO WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE
              PERFORM GET-AUTH-SUMMARY
              SET SEND-ERASE-NO            TO TRUE
              SET NEXT-PAGE-YES            TO TRUE
              MOVE -1                      TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
              PERFORM INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA
              PERFORM PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
           ELSE
              MOVE 'You are already at the top of the page...' TO
                               WS-MESSAGE
              SET SEND-ERASE-NO            TO TRUE
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: PF8 key scrolls forward one page through the authorization list. It uses the last displayed authorization key (CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST) to reposition and fetch the next page. If no next page exists, the message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' is shown.

code_references.snippet:
IF CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES
               MOVE LOW-VALUES             TO WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE
           ELSE
               MOVE CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST TO WS-AUTH-KEY-SAVE
               PERFORM GET-AUTH-SUMMARY
               PERFORM REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS
           END-IF
           ...
           IF NEXT-PAGE-YES
               PERFORM INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA
               PERFORM PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
           ELSE
               MOVE 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'
                                           TO WS-MESSAGE
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: Any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7, or PF8 is invalid. The error flag is set, the message from CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY is displayed, and the cursor is repositioned to the account ID field.

code_references.snippet:
WHEN OTHER
                       MOVE 'Y'              TO WS-ERR-FLG
                       MOVE -1               TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
                       MOVE CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY  TO WS-MESSAGE
                       PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN

business_rules.statement: The authorization approval status displayed on screen is derived from the IMS PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE: a response code of '00' maps to 'A' (Approved); any other response code maps to 'D' (Declined).

code_references.snippet:
IF PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE = '00'
              MOVE 'A'               TO WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT
           ELSE
              MOVE 'D'               TO WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: The screen displays up to five (5) authorization detail records per page. Page forward processing iterates WS-IDX from 1 through 5, populating one screen row per authorization detail segment retrieved from IMS.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE 1             TO  WS-IDX
               MOVE LOW-VALUES    TO CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST
               PERFORM UNTIL WS-IDX > 5 OR AUTHS-EOF OR ERR-FLG-ON
                   ...
                   IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                       PERFORM POPULATE-AUTH-LIST
                       COMPUTE WS-IDX = WS-IDX + 1
                       MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY TO
                                             CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM

business_rules.statement: The existence of a next page is determined by attempting one additional IMS GNP read after filling the five display slots. If another record is found (AUTHS-NOT-EOF), NEXT-PAGE-YES is set to enable PF8 forward navigation; otherwise NEXT-PAGE-NO is set.

code_references.snippet:
IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                   PERFORM GET-AUTHORIZATIONS
                   IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                       SET NEXT-PAGE-YES TO TRUE
                   ELSE
                       SET NEXT-PAGE-NO TO TRUE
                   END-IF
               END-IF

business_rules.statement: The starting authorization key for each page is stored in the array CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG indexed by page number, enabling backward navigation. The first key on each page is stored when WS-IDX equals 2 (i.e., after the second record is confirmed), and the page counter is incremented.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY TO
                                             CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST
                       IF WS-IDX = 2
                          COMPUTE CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM =
                                  CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM + 1
                          MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY TO
                          CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG(CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM)
                       END-IF

business_rules.statement: When PF7 backward scroll is in effect and WS-IDX equals 1, a REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS call is made instead of a normal GET-AUTHORIZATIONS, to reposition the IMS cursor to the saved key before reading forward.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM UNTIL WS-IDX > 5 OR AUTHS-EOF OR ERR-FLG-ON
                   IF EIBAID = DFHPF7 AND WS-IDX = 1
                      PERFORM REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS
                   ELSE
                      PERFORM GET-AUTHORIZATIONS
                   END-IF
                   ...

business_rules.statement: The IMS PSB (PSBPAUTB) must be scheduled before querying the IMS database. If the PSB has already been scheduled (status 'TC'), it is terminated and rescheduled. A CICS SYNCPOINT is issued after releasing the IMS PSB schedule on screen send, ensuring IMS resource cleanup.

code_references.snippet:
SCHEDULE-PSB.
           EXEC DLI SCHD
                PSB((PSB-NAME))
                NODHABEND
           END-EXEC
           MOVE DIBSTAT        TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           IF PSB-SCHEDULED-MORE-THAN-ONCE
              EXEC DLI TERM
              END-EXEC
              EXEC DLI SCHD
                   PSB((PSB-NAME))
                   NODHABEND
              END-EXEC
              MOVE DIBSTAT     TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           END-IF

IF IMS-PSB-SCHD
              SET IMS-PSB-NOT-SCHD      TO TRUE
              EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT
              END-EXEC
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: If no Pending Authorization Summary segment is found for the account in IMS, all authorization summary display fields (approved count, declined count, credit balance, cash balance, approved amount, declined amount) are set to zero on the screen.

code_references.snippet:
ELSE
              MOVE ZERO                   TO APPRCNTO
                                             DECLCNTO
                                             CREDBALO
                                             CASHBALO
                                             APPRAMTO
                                             DECLAMTO
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: The screen header is populated on every send with the current system date and time, the CICS transaction ID ('CPVS'), and the program name ('COPAUS0C').

code_references.snippet:
MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE  TO WS-CURDATE-DATA
           MOVE CCDA-TITLE01           TO TITLE01O OF COPAU0AO
           MOVE CCDA-TITLE02           TO TITLE02O OF COPAU0AO
           MOVE WS-CICS-TRANID         TO TRNNAMEO OF COPAU0AO
           MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY       TO PGMNAMEO OF COPAU0AO
           ...
           MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY    TO CURDATEO OF COPAU0AO
           ...
           MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS    TO CURTIMEO OF COPAU0AO

business_rules.statement: The authorization date displayed is reformatted from the IMS segment's PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE (YYMMDD) into MM/DD/YY display format using WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME(1:2)    TO WS-AUTH-TIME(1:2)
           MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME(3:2)    TO WS-AUTH-TIME(4:2)
           MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME(5:2)    TO WS-AUTH-TIME(7:2)
           MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE(1:2)    TO WS-CURDATE-YY
           MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE(3:2)    TO WS-CURDATE-MM
           MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE(5:2)    TO WS-CURDATE-DD
           MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY       TO WS-AUTH-DATE

business_rules.statement: If CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM is low-values or spaces when returning to a previous screen, the default program 'COSGN00C' (the sign-on program) is used as the navigation target.

code_references.snippet:
IF CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES OR SPACES
               MOVE 'COSGN00C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: The GATHER-DETAILS paragraph resets the page number to zero before gathering authorization data, ensuring pagination starts fresh each time an account is entered.

code_references.snippet:
GATHER-DETAILS.
           MOVE -1       TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
           MOVE 0        TO CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM
           IF WS-ACCT-ID NOT = LOW-VALUES
              PERFORM GATHER-ACCOUNT-DETAILS
              PERFORM INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA
              IF FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
                 PERFORM PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
              END-IF
           END-IF

inputs.statement: CXACAIX — Card Cross-Reference file accessed via alternate index by Account ID. Used to look up card number and customer ID from account ID.

code_references.snippet: 05 WS-CARDXREFNAME-ACCT-PATH  PIC X(8)  VALUE 'CXACAIX '.

MOVE WS-ACCT-ID          TO WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X
           EXEC CICS READ
                DATASET   (WS-CARDXREFNAME-ACCT-PATH)
                RIDFLD    (WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X)
                KEYLENGTH (LENGTH OF WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X)
                INTO      (CARD-XREF-RECORD)
                LENGTH    (LENGTH OF CARD-XREF-RECORD)
                RESP      (WS-RESP-CD)
                RESP2     (WS-REAS-CD)
           END-EXEC

inputs.statement: ACCTDAT — Account Master file. Read by account ID to retrieve account credit limit and cash credit limit.

code_references.snippet: 05 WS-ACCTFILENAME            PIC X(8)  VALUE 'ACCTDAT '.

MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID            TO WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID
           EXEC CICS READ
                DATASET   (WS-ACCTFILENAME)
                RIDFLD    (WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X)
                KEYLENGTH (LENGTH OF WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X)
                INTO      (ACCOUNT-RECORD)
                LENGTH    (LENGTH OF ACCOUNT-RECORD)
                RESP      (WS-RESP-CD)
                RESP2     (WS-REAS-CD)
           END-EXEC

inputs.statement: CUSTDAT — Customer Master file. Read by customer ID to retrieve customer name, address, and phone number for display.

code_references.snippet: 05 WS-CUSTFILENAME            PIC X(8)  VALUE 'CUSTDAT '.

MOVE XREF-CUST-ID              TO WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID
           EXEC CICS READ
                DATASET   (WS-CUSTFILENAME)
                RIDFLD    (WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID-X)
                KEYLENGTH (LENGTH OF WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID-X)
                INTO      (CUSTOMER-RECORD)
                LENGTH    (LENGTH OF CUSTOMER-RECORD)
                RESP      (WS-RESP-CD)
                RESP2     (WS-REAS-CD)
           END-EXEC

inputs.statement: IMS Database — Pending Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0), read via GU DLI call using PSB PSBPAUTB, PCB 1. Provides approved/declined counts and balances for the account.

code_references.snippet:
05 PSB-NAME                        PIC X(8) VALUE 'PSBPAUTB'.
          05 PCB-OFFSET.
             10 PAUT-PCB-NUM                 PIC S9(4) COMP VALUE +1.

MOVE CDEMO-ACCT-ID                   TO PA-ACCT-ID
           EXEC DLI GU USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
               SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
               INTO (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
               WHERE (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID)
           END-EXEC
           MOVE DIBSTAT                          TO IMS-RETURN-CODE

inputs.statement: IMS Database — Pending Authorization Detail segment (PAUTDTL1), read via GNP DLI calls under the summary segment parent. Provides individual authorization transaction records.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC DLI GNP USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
               SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
               INTO (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
           END-EXEC
           MOVE DIBSTAT                          TO IMS-RETURN-CODE

01 PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS.
       COPY CIPAUDTY.

inputs.statement: DFHCOMMAREA — CICS communication area passed between transactions. Carries program context, account ID, customer ID, card number, and pagination state (page number, auth keys, selection flags).

code_references.snippet:
01  DFHCOMMAREA.
         05  LK-COMMAREA                           PIC X(01)
             OCCURS 1 TO 32767 TIMES DEPENDING ON EIBCALEN.
MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

inputs.statement: BMS Map COPAU0A (mapset COPAU00) — The BMS input map receives account ID and selection fields from the terminal operator.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS RECEIVE
                     MAP('COPAU0A')
                     MAPSET('COPAU00')
                     INTO(COPAU0AI)
                     RESP(WS-RESP-CD)
                     RESP2(WS-REAS-CD)
           END-EXEC

outputs.statement: BMS Map COPAU0A (mapset COPAU00) — The BMS output map sends the authorization summary screen to the terminal, including account details, customer details, authorization list rows, and error messages.

code_references.snippet:
IF SEND-ERASE-YES
               EXEC CICS SEND
                         MAP('COPAU0A')
                         MAPSET('COPAU00')
                         FROM(COPAU0AO)
                         ERASE
                         CURSOR
               END-EXEC
           ELSE
               EXEC CICS SEND
                         MAP('COPAU0A')
                         MAPSET('COPAU00')
                         FROM(COPAU0AO)
                         CURSOR
               END-EXEC
           END-IF

outputs.statement: CARDDEMO-COMMAREA — Updated communication area returned to CICS on RETURN with transaction ID 'CPVS', carrying pagination state and selection results for the next transaction cycle.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS RETURN
                     TRANSID (WS-CICS-TRANID)
                     COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC.

processing_logic.statement: Step 1 — Initialization: Error flag is set off, EOF flag set to not-EOF, next-page flag set to no, and send-erase flag set to yes. Message and error message output fields are cleared.

code_references.snippet:
SET ERR-FLG-OFF TO TRUE
           SET AUTHS-NOT-EOF TO TRUE
           SET NEXT-PAGE-NO TO TRUE
           SET SEND-ERASE-YES TO TRUE
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE ERRMSGO OF COPAU0AO
           MOVE -1       TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI

processing_logic.statement: Step 2 — First entry check: If EIBCALEN is zero (no commarea), the commarea is initialized, the program sets itself as the target, marks re-entry, and sends a blank screen to prompt for account ID input.

code_references.snippet:
IF EIBCALEN = 0
               INITIALIZE CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
               MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY    TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
               SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER    TO TRUE
               MOVE LOW-VALUES          TO COPAU0AO
               MOVE -1                  TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
              PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN

processing_logic.statement: Step 3 — First re-entry from another program: Commarea is loaded from DFHCOMMAREA. If not already in re-enter state, account ID from commarea is moved to the screen and GATHER-DETAILS is performed, then the screen is sent with ERASE.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
               IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER
                  SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER     TO TRUE
                  MOVE LOW-VALUES           TO COPAU0AO
                  IF CDEMO-ACCT-ID IS NUMERIC
                     MOVE CDEMO-ACCT-ID     TO WS-ACCT-ID
                                               ACCTIDO OF COPAU0AO
                  ...
                  PERFORM GATHER-DETAILS
                  SET SEND-ERASE-YES TO TRUE
                  PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN

processing_logic.statement: Step 4 — AID key routing: The screen is received and EIBAID is evaluated to route to PROCESS-ENTER-KEY (ENTER), RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN (PF3), PROCESS-PF7-KEY (PF7), PROCESS-PF8-KEY (PF8), or invalid key handling.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM RECEIVE-PAULST-SCREEN
                  EVALUATE EIBAID
                     WHEN DFHENTER
                       PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
                       ...
                     WHEN DFHPF3
                       ...
                     WHEN DFHPF7
                       PERFORM PROCESS-PF7-KEY
                     WHEN DFHPF8
                       PERFORM PROCESS-PF8-KEY
                     WHEN OTHER
                       MOVE 'Y'              TO WS-ERR-FLG
                       ...

processing_logic.statement: Step 5 — GATHER-ACCOUNT-DETAILS: Retrieves card cross-reference data (GETCARDXREF-BYACCT), account data (GETACCTDATA-BYACCT), and customer data (GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST), then formats customer name, address, phone, credit limit, and cash limit for display. Also calls GET-AUTH-SUMMARY to populate authorization summary counts and balances.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM GETCARDXREF-BYACCT
           PERFORM GETACCTDATA-BYACCT
           PERFORM GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST
           MOVE CUST-ID                TO CUSTIDO
           STRING CUST-FIRST-NAME DELIMITED BY SPACES
                  ...
                  INTO CNAMEO
           END-STRING
           ...
           PERFORM GET-AUTH-SUMMARY
           IF FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
              MOVE PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT   TO WS-DISPLAY-COUNT
              ...

processing_logic.statement: Step 6 — PSB Scheduling: Before each IMS query, SCHEDULE-PSB is called to issue EXEC DLI SCHD for PSB PSBPAUTB. If TC (already scheduled), the PSB is terminated and rescheduled.

code_references.snippet:
SCHEDULE-PSB.
           EXEC DLI SCHD
                PSB((PSB-NAME))
                NODHABEND
           END-EXEC
           MOVE DIBSTAT        TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           IF PSB-SCHEDULED-MORE-THAN-ONCE
              EXEC DLI TERM
              END-EXEC
              EXEC DLI SCHD
                   PSB((PSB-NAME))
                   NODHABEND
              END-EXEC
              MOVE DIBSTAT     TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           END-IF

processing_logic.statement: Step 7 — GET-AUTH-SUMMARY: Issues EXEC DLI GU to retrieve the Pending Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0) for the account ID, setting FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG or NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG based on DIBSTAT.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE CDEMO-ACCT-ID                   TO PA-ACCT-ID
           EXEC DLI GU USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
               SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
               INTO (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
               WHERE (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID)
           END-EXEC
           MOVE DIBSTAT                          TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN STATUS-OK
                  SET FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG        TO TRUE
               WHEN SEGMENT-NOT-FOUND
                  SET NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG       TO TRUE
               WHEN OTHER
                  ...

processing_logic.statement: Step 8 — INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA: Clears all five authorization display rows on the screen (fields for transaction ID, date, time, type, approval status, match status, amount, and selection) before populating with new data.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-IDX > 5
             EVALUATE WS-IDX
               WHEN 1
                   MOVE DFHBMPRO TO SEL0001A OF COPAU0AI
                   MOVE SPACES   TO TRNID01I OF COPAU0AI
                   MOVE SPACES   TO PDATE01I OF COPAU0AI
                   ...
             END-EVALUATE
           END-PERFORM

processing_logic.statement: Step 9 — PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD: Loops up to 5 times issuing GET-AUTHORIZATIONS (GNP) calls to read authorization detail child segments, calling POPULATE-AUTH-LIST for each, and tracking pagination keys. A lookahead read determines if a next page exists.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE 1             TO  WS-IDX
               MOVE LOW-VALUES    TO CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST
               PERFORM UNTIL WS-IDX > 5 OR AUTHS-EOF OR ERR-FLG-ON
                   IF EIBAID = DFHPF7 AND WS-IDX = 1
                      PERFORM REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS
                   ELSE
                      PERFORM GET-AUTHORIZATIONS
                   END-IF
                   ...
               END-PERFORM
               IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                   PERFORM GET-AUTHORIZATIONS
                   IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF AND ERR-FLG-OFF
                       SET NEXT-PAGE-YES TO TRUE
                   ELSE
                       SET NEXT-PAGE-NO TO TRUE
                   END-IF
               END-IF

processing_logic.statement: Step 10 — POPULATE-AUTH-LIST: Formats and moves authorization detail fields (transaction ID, date, time, type, approval status, match status, approved amount) into the appropriate BMS map row (1–5) based on WS-IDX, and enables the selection field.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE PA-APPROVED-AMT           TO WS-AUTH-AMT
           MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME(1:2)    TO WS-AUTH-TIME(1:2)
           ...
           EVALUATE WS-IDX
               WHEN 1
                   MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY
                                          TO CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS(1)
                   MOVE PA-TRANSACTION-ID TO TRNID01I OF COPAU0AI
                   MOVE WS-AUTH-DATE      TO PDATE01I OF COPAU0AI
                   ...
                   MOVE DFHBMUNP          TO SEL0001A OF COPAU0AI
               WHEN 2
                   ...
           END-EVALUATE.

processing_logic.statement: Step 11 — SEND-PAULST-SCREEN: If the IMS PSB is scheduled, issues a CICS SYNCPOINT to release IMS resources, then calls POPULATE-HEADER-INFO and sends the BMS map using ERASE (first send) or without ERASE (subsequent sends on same screen).

code_references.snippet:
IF IMS-PSB-SCHD
              SET IMS-PSB-NOT-SCHD      TO TRUE
              EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT
              END-EXEC
           END-IF
           PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
           MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COPAU0AO
           IF SEND-ERASE-YES
               EXEC CICS SEND
                         MAP('COPAU0A')
                         MAPSET('COPAU00')
                         FROM(COPAU0AO)
                         ERASE
                         CURSOR
               END-EXEC
           ...

processing_logic.statement: Step 12 — Termination: After all processing and screen send, EXEC CICS RETURN is issued with transaction ID 'CPVS' and the updated CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, suspending the program until the next terminal input.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS RETURN
                     TRANSID (WS-CICS-TRANID)
                     COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC.

error_handling.statement: IMS PSB scheduling failure: If EXEC DLI SCHD returns a status other than STATUS-OK, WS-ERR-FLG is set to 'Y', a system error message including the IMS return code is built, and the screen is sent with the error. The NODHABEND option prevents automatic abend on DLI error.

code_references.snippet:
IF STATUS-OK
              SET IMS-PSB-SCHD           TO TRUE
           ELSE
              MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-ERR-FLG
              STRING
                  ' System error while scheduling PSB: Code:'
              IMS-RETURN-CODE
              DELIMITED BY SIZE
              INTO WS-MESSAGE
              END-STRING
              MOVE -1       TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
              PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN
           END-IF

error_handling.statement: IMS GET-AUTH-SUMMARY error: If DLI GU for PAUTSUM0 returns a status other than 'OK' or 'GE' (segment not found), WS-ERR-FLG is set and an error message 'System error while reading AUTH Summary: Code:' with the IMS status code is displayed.

code_references.snippet:
WHEN OTHER
                  MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-ERR-FLG
                  STRING
                  ' System error while reading AUTH Summary: Code:'

                  DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  INTO WS-MESSAGE
                  END-STRING
                  MOVE -1       TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI
                  PERFORM SEND-PAULST-SCREEN

error_handling.statement: IMS resource cleanup via CICS SYNCPOINT: Before sending the screen, if the IMS PSB is still scheduled (IMS-PSB-SCHD), a CICS SYNCPOINT is issued to commit and release IMS resources, preventing resource locks from persisting across pseudo-conversational cycles.

code_references.snippet:
IF IMS-PSB-SCHD
              SET IMS-PSB-NOT-SCHD      TO TRUE
              EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT
              END-EXEC
           END-IF

error_handling.statement: IMS PSB 'already scheduled' recovery: If the IMS status is 'TC' (PSB scheduled more than once), the program issues EXEC DLI TERM to unschedule it, then re-schedules with EXEC DLI SCHD, preventing duplicate PSB schedule failures.

code_references.snippet:
IF PSB-SCHEDULED-MORE-THAN-ONCE
              EXEC DLI TERM
              END-EXEC
              EXEC DLI SCHD
                   PSB((PSB-NAME))
                   NODHABEND
              END-EXEC
              MOVE DIBSTAT     TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           END-IF

downstream_effects.statement: COPAUS1C (Authorization Detail program) receives control via CICS XCTL with the CARDDEMO-COMMAREA containing CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED (the selected authorization key) and CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG. It is expected to display the full details of the selected pending authorization record.

code_references.snippet:
IF (CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES)
                   AND
                   (CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES)
                   EVALUATE CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG
                     WHEN 'S'
                     WHEN 's'
                        MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL  TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
                        MOVE WS-CICS-TRANID   TO CDEMO-FROM-TRANID
                        MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM
                        MOVE 0                TO CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT
                        SET CDEMO-PGM-ENTER   TO TRUE
                        EXEC CICS
                            XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM)
                            COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
                        END-EXEC

downstream_effects.statement: COMEN01C (Main Menu program) receives control via CICS XCTL when PF3 is pressed. The commarea passed identifies COPAUS0C as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) and 'CPVS' as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), enabling menu-driven back-navigation context.

code_references.snippet:
IF CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES OR SPACES
               MOVE 'COSGN00C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-CICS-TRANID  TO CDEMO-FROM-TRANID
           MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM
           MOVE ZEROS           TO CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT
           EXEC CICS
               XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM)
               COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC.

downstream_effects.statement: COSGN00C (Sign-on program) is the fallback downstream recipient when no valid return program is set in CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, ensuring the user is redirected to sign-on rather than experiencing a transaction failure.

code_references.snippet:
IF CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES OR SPACES
               MOVE 'COSGN00C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
           END-IF

downstream_effects.statement: The IMS Pending Authorization database (PSB PSBPAUTB) is read but not updated by this program. It is a read-only consumer of the authorization summary and detail segments. Downstream processes that write to this IMS database (e.g., authorization capture programs) will have their data reflected in this summary view.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC DLI GU USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
               SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
               INTO (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
               WHERE (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID)
           END-EXEC

EXEC DLI GNP USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
               SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
               INTO (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
           END-EXEC

downstream_effects.statement: The CICS SYNCPOINT issued in SEND-PAULST-SCREEN affects all recoverable resources within the CICS unit of work at that point, meaning any IMS updates made by other programs sharing the same CICS task unit would also be committed. In this program's context it serves to release the IMS PSB schedule cleanly.

code_references.snippet:
IF IMS-PSB-SCHD
              SET IMS-PSB-NOT-SCHD      TO TRUE
              EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT
              END-EXEC
           END-IF
